scope: Descriptive complete-process-lifecycle trace distributions including startup/seed/warmup/load/recovery/cleanup; not a measurement-window percentile or repeated-process comparison. Exact correlation is internal frame/HostTicket only, not an external business cycle.
scope_limits: Start entry is before managed Start-control setup; terminal is managed callback-field observation, not physical SQL completion.
BeginImmediate pending includes provider/SQLx/SQLite busy handling and runtime/callback scheduling; physical SQLite lock time is unavailable.
OpenSession pending includes native pool admission and runtime scheduling; isolated pool wait is unavailable.
Terminal to BeforeTake includes callback unwind/control readiness and managed coordinator scheduling.
BeforeTake to RetiredObserved includes result taking/materialization, native quiescence and managed continuation observation of Retirement.
AfterRelease hold combines native request release with coordinator/ticket removal; baseline owner-disposal and ticket-remove regions have no acquired timestamp and are not equivalent gates.
Request scope includes dispatch/response/cleanup; admission gate precedes it. This is not client-observed response latency.
Phase disposal does not certify success. Use original independent business oracle and operation outcomes separately.
Cycle consists of create/replay/recovery HTTP calls; no external cycle ID is captured, so these cannot be identity-joined to a specific generator cycle.
Trace profiling and preallocation alter the observer workload. No formal improvement, capacity, long duration or singular cause is inferred.
